research_rationale: This partial candidate retains provisional NO. The complete official EO12182 extract includes its three numbered sections and an expressly incorporated list of seven labor organizations. Six exact spans preserve the party-scope incorporation, board establishment, member-disqualification rule, reporting duty, continuing no-change rule, and attached list; signature/editorial furniture is excluded from operative quotations. The held PDF hash matches GPO fixity and there is no material text or completeness ambiguity; page images were not inspected. Full EO12379 section7 immediately revokes EO12182, without deferred effective wording elsewhere in that actor; August17,1982 is recorded only as a later formal revocation event. Section1-103 is a concrete earlier-ending mechanism dependent on actual report plus30days and an agreement exception, and remains distinct from section1-102 reporting deadline. Since the actual report and relevant agreement history are not established, no first-end or whole-order date is inferred. Bounded later-number/regulatory searches and explicit rejection of cross-actor machine contamination do not supply those occurrence facts.
unresolved_material_gaps: Actual completion of the EO12182 board investigation and actual report to the President have not been established. Section1-102 imposes a30-day reporting deadline only. The report deadline is not proof of performance or a first-end date.

Section1-103 independently maintains the disputed conditions until30days after the board actually reports, with an express agreement exception. The missing actual report date and any relevant agreement/settlement defining earlier permitted changes leave its first end and substantive residual effects unresolved. Section10 of the Railway Labor Act (45USC160), expressly invoked for this rule, has not been read in a held historical statutory text. No whole_order_end is asserted.
